rd.title: Remote Desktop
rd.subtitle: Connect to another computer over RDP or VNC.
rd.userHintVnc: Only if the computer asks for one
rd.domainHint: Leave empty if you don’t use one
rd.name: Display name
rd.saveHint: Keep it in your saved computers
rd.rememberHint: Kept encrypted on this server, only for you
rd.err.host: Enter the computer’s name or IP address.
rd.clipboard.to-remote: Only from here to the computer
rd.clipboard.from-remote: Only from the computer to here
rd.audioHint: The computer’s sound plays on this device
rd.ignoreCertHint: Connect even when its identity can’t be verified
rd.ignoreCertWarn: Only for computers you trust on your own network: someone pretending to be this computer could see what you type.
rd.gatewayHint: Only if your organisation reaches computers through a gateway.
rd.sort.name: Name
rd.emptyHint: Connect to one with “Save this connection” on and it shows up here.
rd.noMatches: No saved computers match your search.
rd.del.title: Delete {name}?
rd.del.body: The saved connection and its remembered password are removed. Nothing changes on the computer itself.
rd.cred.title: Enter your credentials
rd.cred.body: These are used to connect to {name}.
rd.cred.wrong: That user name or password didn’t work. Try again.
rd.cred.notKept: The password is sent once to start the session and isn’t stored.
rd.fail.authHint: {name} didn’t accept the sign-in. Check the user name and password and try again.
rd.fail.unreachableHint: Make sure {host} is on, on the network, and that remote connections are allowed on it.
rd.fail.certHint: Its certificate couldn’t be checked, which is normal for computers on a home or office network. It can also mean a different security mode is needed.
rd.fail.certWarn: Connect anyway only if you trust this computer.
rd.fail.securityHint: {name} wants a different security mode. Pick another one under Show options → Advanced.
rd.fail.engine: The remote desktop engine isn’t ready
rd.fail.engineHint: NoCapOS couldn’t start the part that talks to other computers. Try again in a moment.
rd.fail.otherHint: Something went wrong while connecting to {host}.
rd.bar.label: Connection bar
rd.keys.typeHint: What you type here goes straight to the computer
rd.clip.hint: Text copied on the computer shows up here. Edit it and send it back.
rd.clip.hintSendOnly: Paste text here to send it to the computer.
